name: MedExpQA
description: MedExpQA is the first multilingual benchmark for medical question answering that includes reference gold explanations written by medical doctors, enabling evaluation of LLM reasoning in multiple languages and highlighting challenges in medical knowledge integration.
reputation: A newer benchmark that has attracted interest in multilingual medical QA, but it is not yet a standard long-established benchmark in the community.
notes: Addresses multilingual evaluation and includes gold explanations; shows performance drop in non-English languages.
